steps.name: Raise and system-validate purchase requisition
steps.description: Requester submits a requisition that the system validates against budget and supplier master data at entry.

steps.name: Approve by exception
steps.description: Only requisitions breaching a value or budget threshold are routed to the cost centre manager; the rest are auto-approved.

steps.name: Auto-issue purchase order and match invoice
steps.description: System issues the purchase order on approval and performs the match against the goods receipt note and supplier invoice, posting the payable when all three agree.

disposition_mapping.rationale: DUMMY. Still performed by the requester, but budget and supplier checks move to point of entry, so downstream rework is avoided.
DUMMY. Approval is retained as a control but routed by exception, so the manager sees only threshold breaches.
DUMMY. Purchase order issue is merged into the automated step TS-03; no manual conversion remains.
DUMMY. Invoice matching is merged into TS-03, where the system performs the match that the clerk performed manually.
